definitions.explanation: The eye on the left side of the face.

examples.japanese: {左|ひだり}{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かゆい→かゆい：02340_kayui⟧。
{左|ひだり}{目|め}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{視力|しりょく}→視力：05033_shiryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧きた。
examples.english: The vision in just my left eye has been getting worse.

examples.japanese: ⟦だるま→だるま：06539_daruma⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}→願い事：14621_negaigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{左|ひだり}{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}き{入|い}れる→書き入れる：13052_kakiireru⟧。
examples.english: With a daruma, you fill in the left eye when you make a wish.

notes:
Refers to the left eye from the point of view of the person whose eye it is.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {左|ひだり}{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つぶる→つぶる：29078_tsuburu⟧: to close/wink the left eye
